response.overview: Went for a drive with Caden to take some pictures of the old Bruce Mansfield plant (because I am very much obsessed with it) and met a really cool kid fishing for catfish down by the river. He told us we spooked him cause the woods we were in are haunted and he'd gotten possessed by a demon a year back up in an abandoned house down the road. We asked him to show us and he gave us a very cool tour of a very overgrown neighborhood. I wish I had more footage of the houses but my camera died very quickly and suddenly once we got inside....  I'll miss you, Pennsylvania.
response.title: i'm gonna be someone, someday
